plainTranslation: Drive meets brake. The Mars person pushes; the Saturn person structures, slows, or stops. At best, Saturn turns Mars's raw energy into disciplined, lasting work. At worst, the Mars person feels constantly blocked and criticized while the Saturn person feels they're minding a loose cannon. Failure mode: Saturn controlling Mars, or chronic frustration. Build something together; don't let one police the other's drive.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep:
This person brings you face to face with the reality of your actions. Around them, you become more aware of timing, responsibility, consequences, and the effort required to make something last. If you tend to move quickly, their presence can help you slow down enough to see what you're building. If you're eager to act, however, it may feel as though every impulse is being asked to prove itself before it can move forward. What you want to do meets the question of what it will take to sustain it.

When this works, they help your energy find direction. Instead of acting on every impulse, you learn how to focus your effort, choose your timing more carefully, and stay with a goal after the excitement of beginning has passed. Their influence may not always feel encouraging, but it can help you develop greater self-control.

There is real value in what they offer. Desire can get something started, but it is discipline that carries it through. This person may help you develop the patience to stay with the process, the resilience to keep going when things get difficult, and the commitment needed to create results that last.

The difficulty comes when their restraint feels less like guidance and more like a barrier. You may begin to feel stopped before you have a chance to act, questioned before you have a chance to try, or made to doubt instincts that once felt clear. When every step feels subject to their judgment, resentment can grow.

Let this connection teach you how to move with more strength, but do not let it train you to stop moving.
